posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
La Capitan

La Capitan [75]

In Play: La Paradoja Magnifica [15]

Trash: n/a

Additional Effects:

* SV: If there are 3+ cards beneath La Capitan, she flips.  Whenever she destroys a Hero card, it goes under La Capitan.  Destroy a Hero Ongoing/Equipment card (Advanced)

*EV: Deal highest hp Hero target H-1 Projectile.

* La Paradoja Magnifica: EV: Play the top card of the Villain Deck; SV: Shuffle Villain Trash into the Villain Deck

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

 

Start of Villain Turn: Flip?  Nope.  No Hero cards in play to destroy.

Play a Card:   Walk the Plank!  Haka takes 3 damage [30] and cannot use Powers this turn.

End of Villain Turn:: Haka takes 4 projectile damage [26].  

La Paradoja Magnifica lets La Capitan play another Villain Card:  All Together Now--La Capitan deals either Fixer or Bunker 1 Lightning damage.  The boat is already in play.

 

______________________________________________________________________________________________________

Additional Effects:

SV: If there are 3+ cards beneath La Capitan, she flips.  Whenever she destroys a Hero card, it goes beneath La Capitan.  Destroy a Hero Ongoing/Equipment card.

EV: Deal highest hp Hero target H-1 Projectile damage.
